_what: Tier 1 of the supplier seed backfill: the 33 companies named on 3 or more clinical NHS Supply Chain frameworks and held in no Hub supplier section. Source list: Product-Build/market-intelligence/SEED-BACKFILL-WORKLIST.md, generated by reconcile_suppliers.py.
_rule: Companies House was searched by name for each. A NAME SEARCH IS NOT A CONFIRMATION - per docs/COMPANY-REPORT-METHOD.md a company number is only 'confirmed' via route 1 (an anchored number curated into the record) or route 2 (the number the company publishes on its own site). So no number here is written to `companyNumber`. Where the registered name matches exactly and the company is active, the result is recorded as a CANDIDATE, carrying its own status and date, for confirm_company_numbers.py to prove or discard later. The verified fact in every record created from this file is the framework award, nothing else.

_verdicts.candidate: Registered name matches the awarded name exactly and the company is active. Recorded as a candidate number, never as a confirmed one.
_verdicts.probable: A plausible single match that is not an exact name match. Recorded as a candidate and flagged for route 2.
_verdicts.unresolved: No defensible match. Companies House returned nothing close, or several equally plausible companies. No number recorded. This is the correct output, not a failure.
_verdicts.foreign: Not a UK-registered company, so no Companies House record is expected to exist. Recorded with no number and a note saying so.
_verdicts.alias: Not a separate supplier - another spelling of a company already in this list. Becomes an alias, never its own record.

companies.name: Meril UK Pvt Ltd
companies.why: The awarded name carries 'Pvt Ltd', the Indian parent's suffix, which no UK entity uses. MERIL UK LIMITED is the only plausible UK company and the group is a real medtech manufacturer, but the suffix mismatch means this is not an exact-name match. Route 2 before any number is asserted.

companies.name: Global Health and Safety Ltd
companies.why: Differs only by '&' for 'and', which normally resolves. Held at probable because the top name-search hits include GLOBAL OFFSHORE WIND HEALTH AND SAFETY ORGANISATION and a dissolved GLOBAL HEALTH AND SAFETY SERVICES LTD, so the name is not distinctive enough to settle on its own. The awarded company sits on wound care and theatre wear frameworks; confirm the trade matches before asserting.

companies.name: Cardiac Services
companies.why: CARDIAC SERVICES LTD (13965840) was incorporated 2022-03-09, and at least three other active companies carry the same words (AB, AH, AM Cardiac Services). The best-known Cardiac Services is a long-established Belfast business, which the 2022 incorporation date does not fit. Several equally plausible companies is exactly the case where nothing is recorded.

companies.name: Cardiac Services UK Ltd
companies.why: No company of this name exists. The nearest hits are CARDIAC AND THORACIC SURGERY UK and CARDIAC CARE UK LTD, neither of which is this. May also be the same trading business as 'Cardiac Services' above; resolve both together, not separately.

companies.name: HC21 (UK) Ltd
companies.why: Companies House returns nothing but a dissolved MISS TINA'S HC21 LTD. Likely a trading name rather than a registered one.

companies.name: TLB Medical Supplies
companies.why: TLB SUPPLIES LTD (13410609) shares only the initials and drops 'Medical'. Every other hit is an unrelated medical supplies company matching on the generic words. Not enough to settle.

companies.name: Balmung Medical Handel GmbH
companies.why: A GmbH is German-registered, so no Companies House record is expected. BALMUNG MEDICAL UK LTD (13142809) exists and may be a UK subsidiary, but it is a different legal entity from the one NHS Supply Chain named, and recording it here would assert a corporate relationship nobody has checked.

companies.name: Rudolf Riester GmbH
companies.why: German-registered diagnostic instrument manufacturer. Companies House returns only Rudolf Steiner schools and estates, matching on the forename.

companies.name: Banner
companies.why: The bare word appears on three frameworks where 'Banner Group Limited' appears on six. BANNER LIMITED (07464584) is a separate registered company, but treating a one-word supplier name as its own record would put the same business on the compare tab twice. Recorded as an alias; if the two are genuinely different businesses, that is a question for Lou, not something to settle in code.
